advancements.meridian_humanoid_host.cult: Most villagers know only a few plain skills: Breathing, Light Step and Charge. Still, they are no easy mark once a fight starts.
The trader leading llamas walks the Thousand-Mile Leg: an ordinary one knows Road, one who has refined true qi also knows Ambush, and a rare few master Journey.
A pillager's crossbow follows the Wayfarer's way; one who has refined true qi also draws the Hundred Paces bow, and a rare few master Myriad Arrows.
A vindicator's axe is made for doors: it splits wooden doors, wooden trapdoors and fence gates but never strikes iron; those who have refined true qi know more, and a rare few master Myriad Doors.
Swamp witches know the Nourish form of the Potion Arts, and those who have refined true qi also know Lure; they have brewed all their lives and often carry recipes.
Cultivators carry their technique scrolls with them. Only when you defeat, with your own hands, someone who knows the art may their scroll fall to you.
[Preface]
The Practised resemble normal Villagers or Pillagers, but hold true skill: Wandering Qi or True Qi. True Qi ones are harder and know one more manual. All know three basics: Breath, Light Step, and Charge.

Wind-ups break to heavy hits: blunt best, blades next, arrows third; fire, ice, poison fail. They stagger: no new move, half speed. Moves under 0.5s or mere shoves cannot break. They also interrupt your slow moves.

Badly hurt, a limb near ruin, or arms spent, they Light Step or walk away, hitting back if pressed. Beyond 12 blocks, they pant, then chime: Breath, taking about 1s, breakable. Afterward limbs recover fast, but blood does not return.

Healed back past half, arms near full, 12 blocks off, they return; cornered, they fight to the end. Harm one, allies within 16 blocks grudge for half a minute. Get 32 blocks off and out of sight to shake them. Slay one who knows a whole manual and it may drop.

[Vindicator]
At 4 to 24 blocks, he stands to Charge, gasps, a faint ping, then Light Steps to 1.5 blocks away to strike. He stands still until his axe lands, then follows slowly. Afterward his arms weaken for 6 to 9 seconds—press him then!

Knock: 3 hits (<0.5s, unbreakable). Door Breaker: 1.6s chop. Door Ram rams. Shield Breaker breaks shields. Sweep: 1.7s, hits 5 max. Shut Door: 2 hops back, axe. Door Chain: 3 slashes. Ten Thousand Doors: 2.1s, leaps, cleaves 4 blocks ahead.

Slow moves over 1.5s startup are only used within 2.5 blocks of you, and never right after being hit. Door Breaker and Ten Thousand Doors break wooden doors, trapdoors, and fence gates within 2 blocks, but not iron doors.

[Wandering Trader]
Snap Kick: 1s, unbreakable. Push Kick. Mule Kick (unbreakable launch). Ground Sweep trips. True Qi traders, under half hurt and facing you alone, attack: Whip Kick, Chain Kicks, Flying Kick (8 blocks), Leave No Trace (2.8s).

Axe Kick downs shielded or leaping foes. If legs tire or kicks aren't ready, he retreats without kicking or jumping. Cornered and ready, he steps to 2 blocks and waits facing you; if not, he sidles along the wall, switching corners once you are 3 blocks off.

[Pillager]
Alert within 100 blocks, he closes in to shoot. Repeater users fire from 92 to 96 blocks away; Pearl String users from 81 to 85 blocks. As you rush in, they step back to maintain range. Their arrows reach that far.

Still past 16 blocks: Kneeling Shot, Full Moon. Moving: 5-shot Repeater or Pearl String. Inside 8 blocks: Crosswind (6 arrows) if two or more foes or in 3 blocks with crossbow; Bow Tip bash and shot if bow in 3 blocks; else shoots.

If sight is lost, he searches; those with Ten Thousand Arrows loose an Arrow Rain. If heavily hurt and pursued, he uses Parting Shot, firing while retreating. True Qi Pillagers carry an extra bow, swapping between bow and crossbow.

[Witch]
Hurt in arms and legs, none within 8 blocks, she stands to Imbibe (3 gulps, over 3s); if hurt badly in one spot, she will Anoint. Both break. Pressed or surrounded, she throws Charm; within 2 blocks, she drops it at her own feet.

True Qi Witches lob from 4 to 14 blocks: Armor Rot vs heavy armor, Withering if fleeing. In 3.5 blocks, she splashes, then mists: tainted foes in 16 blocks suffer again at half effect, through walls. A bucket of milk clears it.

[Evoker]
Practised Evokers no longer dye sheep red. True Qi ones chant past 8 blocks, hands glowing for 2s (breakable). For about 18s after, his attacks and summoned Fangs and Vex inflict extra harm of that element.
Beyond 12 blocks, he takes 2 to 3 seconds to cast Thick Earth or Returning Water, bolstering his legs and speeding recovery. When his hands glow, strike hard during those 2 seconds to interrupt him.

[Villager]
Villagers know basics but never strike. Facing foes they Light Step back and Breath afar. If enemies threaten, 3 Villagers summon an Iron Golem. Harm one, and Villagers, traders, and Iron Golems in 16 blocks grudge for half a minute.

[Afterword]
Pillagers, Vindicators, Evokers, Witches, Illusioners are one band; Villagers, traders, Iron Golems another. Your wolves or summons count as you: they hit one only if it bites them and you are out of reach. Smash wind-ups with blunt force.
